```{python}
#| label: datos-base
#| output: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

files = sorted(Path("../lake/serving/indicador_diario").glob("fecha=*/indicador_diario.parquet"))
df = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(f) for f in files], ignore_index=True) if files else pd.DataFrame()
ult = df["fecha"].max() if not df.empty else "s/d"
base = df[df["fecha"] == ult].copy() if not df.empty else df

def f1(x, dec=1):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:.{dec}f}"

def entero(x):
    return "s/d" if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and pd.isna(x)) else f"{x:,.0f}"
```

## 01 · Estado de hoy

```{python}
#| label: kpis
#| output: asis
tmed = base["temp_media_c"].median()
prec = base["precipitacion_mm"].sum()
pl = base.dropna(subset=["precipitacion_mm"])
plmax = pl.loc[pl["precipitacion_mm"].idxmax()] if not pl.empty else None
vi = base.dropna(subset=["viento_max_kmh"])
vimax = vi.loc[vi["viento_max_kmh"].idxmax()] if not vi.empty else None

def card(valor, unidad, etiqueta):
    return (f'<div class="kpi kpi-clima"><div class="kpi-valor">{valor}'
            f'<span class="kpi-unidad">{unidad}</span></div>'
            f'<div class="kpi-etiqueta">{etiqueta}</div></div>')

cards = [
    card(f1(tmed), "°C", "Temp. media · global"),
    card(entero(prec), "mm", "Precipitación total · red"),
    card(f1(plmax["precipitacion_mm"]) if plmax is not None else "s/d", "mm",
         f'Mayor lluvia · {plmax["ciudad"]}' if plmax is not None else "Mayor lluvia"),
    card(f1(vimax["viento_max_kmh"], 0) if vimax is not None else "s/d", "km/h",
         f'Viento máx · {vimax["ciudad"]}' if vimax is not None else "Viento máx"),
]
print('<div class="kpi-row">' + "".join(cards) + "</div>")
```

## 02 · Visor climático

Color por temperatura media, tamaño por lluvia del día.

::: {.map-wrap}
```{python}
#| label: visor-clima
#| fig-cap: "Temperatura media (color) y precipitación (tamaño)"
import folium
from folium.plugins import MarkerCluster, Fullscreen, MiniMap
from branca.element import MacroElement
from folium.template import Template
import branca.colormap as cm

ESRI_SAT = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"
col_temp = cm.LinearColormap(["#2166ac", "#fee08b", "#b2182b"], vmin=0, vmax=35, caption="Temp. media °C")


class EcoMobile(MacroElement):
    """Comportamiento móvil sin leyenda propia: no atrapa el scroll,
    colapsa la ayuda en pantallas chicas. El colormap de branca ya es
    un control Leaflet y viaja con el fullscreen."""
    _template = Template("""
        {% macro header(this, kwargs) %}
        <style>
        .eco-hint{background:#fff;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;color:#6c757d;
          padding:6px 9px;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.25);max-width:220px}
        </style>
        {% endmacro %}
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function(){
          var mapObj = {{this._parent.get_name()}};
          mapObj.scrollWheelZoom.disable();
          if (window.innerWidth < 640 && mapObj.dragging) {
            mapObj.dragging.disable();
            mapObj.once('click', function(){ mapObj.dragging.enable(); });
          }
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
    """)

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = "EcoMobile"


m = folium.Map(location=[-12, -62], zoom_start=3, tiles=None, control_scale=True,
               preferCanvas=True, scrollWheelZoom=False)
folium.TileLayer("OpenStreetMap", name="Calles OSM").add_to(m)
folium.TileLayer(tiles=ESRI_SAT, attr="Esri", name="Satélite").add_to(m)
mc = MarkerCluster(name="Clima").add_to(m)
for _, p in base.dropna(subset=["temp_media_c"]).iterrows():
    ll = 0 if pd.isna(p["precipitacion_mm"]) else float(p["precipitacion_mm"])
    folium.CircleMarker(
        [p["lat"], p["lon"]], radius=4 + min(ll, 60) / 8,
        color=col_temp(float(p["temp_media_c"])), fill=True, fill_opacity=0.85,
        tooltip=f"{p['ciudad']}: {p['temp_media_c']:.1f} °C · {ll:.1f} mm",
        popup=folium.Popup(
            f"<b>{p['ciudad']}</b> ({p['pais']})<table>"
            f"<tr><td>T. máx</td><td><b>{f1(p['temp_max_c'])} °C</b></td></tr>"
            f"<tr><td>T. mín</td><td><b>{f1(p['temp_min_c'])} °C</b></td></tr>"
            f"<tr><td>Lluvia</td><td><b>{ll:.1f} mm</b></td></tr>"
            f"<tr><td>Viento máx</td><td><b>{f1(p['viento_max_kmh'])} km/h</b></td></tr></table>",
            max_width=280),
    ).add_to(mc)
col_temp.add_to(m)
EcoMobile().add_to(m)
MiniMap(toggle_display=True, position="bottomright", width=100, height=100).add_to(m)
Fullscreen(position="topright", title="Pantalla completa",
           title_cancel="Salir de pantalla completa", force_separate_button=True).add_to(m)
folium.LayerControl(collapsed=True).add_to(m)
m
```
:::

## 03 · Análisis

```{python}
#| label: graficos-clima
import plotly.express as px

top = base.dropna(subset=["precipitacion_mm"]).sort_values("precipitacion_mm", ascending=False).head(20)
fig1 = px.bar(top, x="precipitacion_mm", y="ciudad", color="region",
              title="Top 20 precipitación (mm/día)",
              labels={"precipitacion_mm": "mm", "ciudad": "Ciudad"})
fig1.update_layout(height=480, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig1.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})

fig2 = px.scatter(base.dropna(subset=["temp_media_c", "precipitacion_mm"]),
                  x="temp_media_c", y="precipitacion_mm", color="region", hover_name="ciudad",
                  title="Temperatura vs precipitación",
                  labels={"temp_media_c": "Temp. media °C", "precipitacion_mm": "Precipitación mm"})
fig2.update_layout(height=380, margin=dict(l=50, r=20, t=75, b=40))
fig2.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modebarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]})
```
